import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Calculate total spending per customer
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Calculate age
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending (main insight)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Income'], df['Total_Spending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Customer Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Spending by Product Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                      'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(category_labels))
ax2.pie(category_totals, labels=category_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Spending Distribution\nby Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Education Level Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
education_counts = df['Education'].value_counts()
ax3.barh(education_counts.index, education_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('muted')[0])
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Education Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Customer Education Levels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Marital Status vs Average Spending
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_spending = df.groupby('Marital_Status')['Total_Spending'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(marital_spending)), marital_spending.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(marital_spending)))
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(marital_spending)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(marital_spending.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Avg Spending by Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Children at Home vs Spending
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_spending = df.groupby('Total_Children')['Total_Spending'].mean()
ax5.plot(children_spending.index, children_spending.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='darkblue')
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Children at Home', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Impact of Children on Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_totals = [df[ch].sum() for ch in channels]
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
ax6.bar(channel_labels, channel_totals, color=sns.color_palette('Set3', len(channel_labels)))
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Purchases', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Purchase Channel Preferences', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [(df[cmp].sum() / len(df) * 100) for cmp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
bars = ax7.bar(campaign_labels, acceptance_rates, color=sns.color_palette('Spectral', len(campaign_labels)))
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Marketing Campaign Success', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Age Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.axvline(df['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Age"].mean():.1f}')
ax8.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.legend()
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
